purpose: Acquire a pinned Qwen3.5-9B Q4_K_M evaluation candidate and run a bounded serial A/B against the current Qwen3-8B. The candidate never binds the production model port and cannot become production authority from this scope.
boundaries: pull-request validation jobs receive no model-host operational credentials and perform no model-host mutation
candidate acquisition is owner-command-only after trusted workflow code is on main
candidate bytes are stored outside Git under /srv/tai-models/candidates and are bound to exact size and SHA-256
the serial A/B may stop the current tai-qwen3-8b.service only inside a bounded evaluation window; candidate binds 127.0.0.1:18081, never the production model port
a systemd fail-safe plus process-parent death handling restores the current service; exact baseline model identity, executable and argv are re-verified after the window
candidate admission requires zero candidate process swap, at least 3 GiB MemAvailable both before and after inference, deterministic quality gates and bounded latency comparison
no API/Web/database/tenant/Deal/money/outbox mutation and no production model identity change
candidate cannot satisfy production model provenance or admission by itself
all transport uses the existing pinned dedicated model-host SSH identity and protected sudo credential only from the owner-command job
